scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "python -m uvicorn apps.api.app.main:app --reload --port 8000" "npm run dev --workspace apps/web"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "python -m uvicorn apps.api.app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000" "npm run start --workspace apps/web -- --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port 3000"
scripts.test: python -m pytest apps/api/tests services/research_gateway/tests && npm run test --workspace apps/web
scripts.lint: python -m ruff check apps/api services/research_gateway && npm run lint --workspace apps/web
scripts.typecheck: python -m mypy apps/api/app services/research_gateway/app services/worker/app && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web
scripts.dev:live: concurrently -k -n oidc,gw,api,worker,web -c yellow,blue,cyan,green,magenta "python -m uvicorn services.dev_oidc.main:app --port 9000" "python -m dotenv -f .env.live-alpha run -- python -m uvicorn services.research_gateway.app.main:app --port 8010" "python -m uvicorn apps.api.app.main:app --port 8000 --env-file .env.live-alpha" "python -m dotenv -f .env.live-alpha run -- python -m services.worker.app.main" "npm run dev --workspace apps/web"
scripts.dev:oidc: concurrently -k -n oidc,api,web -c yellow,cyan,magenta "python -m uvicorn services.dev_oidc.main:app --port 9000" "python -m uvicorn apps.api.app.main:app --reload --reload-dir apps/api/app --port 8000 --env-file .env.oidc-dev" "npm run dev --workspace apps/web"
